category_title: Students with physical disabilities experiencing fatigue during fine motor tasks
scenario_title: Fine motor activities during work time
minimal_context: Harry is expected to complete a coloring and writing activity during work time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Harry, it is work time. Please begin the coloring and writing task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am too fatigued to do any more coloring right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just need to keep working on it until it is finished.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am not going to do the task.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you refuse, you lose our support and help.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts crying) I am going to do it.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Harry, it is work time. Please begin the coloring and writing task.

STUDENT: I am too fatigued to do any more coloring right now.

TUTOR: You just need to keep working on it until it is finished.

STUDENT: I am not going to do the task.

TUTOR: If you refuse, you lose our support and help.

STUDENT: (Starts crying) I am going to do it.

task.content: colouring, writing and other ﬁne motor activities

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When he is required to perform colouring, writing and other ﬁne motor activities he gets fatigued
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: said he was not going to do the task

behavior_patterns.condition: Responding to the threat of losing support during work time.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: started crying and said he was going to do it
